independent.derivation: Independently derived values; no upstream token values or prose copied.

rationale: soft uses 4/8/12px corners for small controls, cards and large panels. Full rounding is reserved for pills.
use: General product UI with restrained corners.
avoid: Do not change existing component corners without checking nested shapes and clipping. Full rounding does not make every rectangle a suitable pill.

--ds-radius-small.derivation: soft: small corner independently selected from a 2px grid.

--ds-radius-medium.derivation: soft: medium corner independently selected from a 2px grid.

--ds-radius-large.derivation: soft: large corner independently selected from a 2px grid.

--ds-radius-full.derivation: Oversized radius is clamped by CSS to half the box dimensions; not a layout size.

guidance: Small: 28–40px controls; medium: cards and 40–56px controls; large: larger panels. These are starting roles, not automatic size rules.
Nested corners need a radius consistent with their inset; do not blindly repeat the outer radius.
